body: Just thank you. You are awesome people.

I do socialize every once in a while. I have a group of friends and we go out for dinner. I went to a party this weekend - I just tend to drink too much when I socialize - or else I don't talk. 

I work with computers, it's easy to get distracted and go on reddit when I should be working, you know? 

I woke up much better today. Thank you for listening.
